name: roblox-3d-studio
description: Voiceover → fully animated Roblox-style 3D video. Claude writes the scenes as code: blocky avatars with clothes, hair, hats and faces, 60+ animations (walk, run, jump, fights, falls, gestures, dances), multi-character interactions, cinematic camera moves, sets, lighting, shadows, particles, lip-sync to the voiceover, auto SFX, music and a final MP4. Three.js rendered frame by frame; no image AI.
